meta.description: DNAnexus cloud genomics platform. Build apps/applets, manage data (upload/download), dxpy Python SDK, run workflows, FASTQ/BAM/VCF, for genomics pipeline development and execution.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus云上构建和运行基因组学分析流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上开发基因组学应用或管理测序数据
copy.tagline_en: Build and run genomics pipelines on the DNAnexus cloud platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop genomics apps or manage sequencing data on DNAnexus

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你操作 DNAnexus 云基因组平台：上传下载文件、运行分析任务、构建应用和工作流，以及用 Python SDK 编写自动化脚本。
howto.when: 当你需要处理基因组数据（如 FASTQ、BAM、VCF），或管理 DNAnexus 上的项目、应用、任务时触发。

say.text: 列出项目里所有 BAM 文件并下载到本地。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并下载文件。

say.text: 创建一个简单的 DNAnexus 应用，输入 FASTQ 输出过滤后的文件。
say.note: Claude 会生成应用代码和配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you operate the DNAnexus cloud genomics platform: upload/download files, run analysis jobs, build apps and workflows, and write automation scripts using the Python SDK.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to process genomic data (e.g., FASTQ, BAM, VCF) or manage projects, apps, and jobs on DNAnexus.

say_en.text: Upload sample.fastq to project-xxxx and run alignment.
say_en.note: Claude will generate upload and run code.

say_en.text: List all BAM files in the project and download them locally.
say_en.note: Claude will search and download files.

say_en.text: Create a simple DNAnexus app that takes FASTQ and outputs filtered reads.
say_en.note: Claude will generate app code and config.
